results.name: Nine application tables and questionnaire seed installed
Create independent test personas and verify API authentication
Anonymous and unauthorized workflow requests are denied
Requester creates vendor; administrator assigns independent reviewers
Unauthorized users cannot read vendors or change reviewer assignments
Assigned assessor issues a versioned assessment; retry is idempotent
Incomplete answers and missing evidence reject submission
Conditional controls activate from their parent answers
Critical failure creates a finding and remediation task despite low average
Repeated submission cannot duplicate findings or remediation
Failed assessment blocks final approval and cannot waive critical controls
Submitted scores, response answers and questionnaire versions are immutable
Attachment ACLs deny unauthorized evidence access
Remediation requires evidence and independent verification
Reassessment passes after verified remediation
New questionnaire version preserves history and invalidates stale approvals
Only the assigned independent approver can approve the vendor
Self-approval is blocked when requester is also the assigned approver
Noncritical findings require remediation or an independently approved exception
Reminder job and notifications are installed and maintenance is repeatable
Expiry is checked at decision time; expired exceptions block pending approvals
Decision history is recorded and report definitions are installed
All three Flow Designer flows execute their lifecycle actions
